idea-plugin.name: CC Sessions
idea-plugin.description:
Session manager for Claude Code CLI: browse, resume, archive and clean up your Claude Code sessions right in the IDE.

  • Sessions panel for the current project (from ~/.claude/projects), grouped by day: search including full text, favorites, tags, rename (the name works with claude --resume <name>).
  • Resume or fork a session in one click, in a built-in terminal tab next to your files, with your own Claude Code plugins, hooks and status line.
  • Live status of parallel sessions via an asynchronous hook: thinking, running a tool, waiting for permission, finished.
  • Transcript viewer: Markdown, collapsed tool calls, diffs of edits, file navigation, export to Markdown.
  • Archive and delete sessions; the archive is shared with JetBrains Air.

What the plugin changes on disk (only on your action, with confirmation where it matters):

  • Enabling live status adds separate asynchronous hook entries to ~/.claude/settings.json (a backup is made first; your own hooks are left untouched) and installs a small hook binary to ~/.claude/cc-sessions/bin.
  • Archive and Rename append a title record to the session transcript, in the same format Claude Code /rename and JetBrains Air use.
  • Delete permanently removes the session transcript and its service files.

Nothing is sent over the network. Requires Claude Code CLI. The plugin UI is in Russian.

Unofficial plugin, not affiliated with Anthropic.

Менеджер сессий Claude Code вокруг настоящего CLI.

  • Панель сессий проекта из ~/.claude/projects с группировкой по дням: поиск (в т. ч. по тексту), избранное, теги, переименование (имя работает в claude --resume <имя>).
  • Продолжить / ответвить сессию в один клик — во вкладке встроенного терминала рядом с файлами, с вашими плагинами, хуками и статуслайном.
  • Live-статус параллельных сессий через асинхронный хук: думает, выполняет инструмент, ждёт разрешения, закончила.
  • Просмотр транскрипта: Markdown, свёрнутые вызовы инструментов, diff правок, переход к файлам, экспорт в Markdown.
  • Архив и удаление сессий; архив общий с JetBrains Air.

Неофициальный плагин, не связан с Anthropic.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0 — first public release.

  • Sessions panel with day groups, favorites, tags, full-text search.
  • Resume / fork in a terminal tab in the editor area; double-click resumes a session.
  • Live status via an asynchronous hook, notifications.
  • Transcript viewer with Markdown export.
  • Archive (shared with JetBrains Air), rename via /rename or the transcript, permanent delete.
